author: gtavi_countdown
text:
GTA 6 developers are receiving signed copies from Rockstar and many are taking a well deserved break ahead of launch.

More than 1600 employees across the UK are currently voting on whether to form a union, which will provide a framework for them to negotiate pay, overtime, bonuses, leave and pension.

author: gameroll_
text:
GTA 6 is putting a LOT of focus into player choice. Rob Nelson has repeatedly expressed that it will be up to the player whether or not they choose to engage with the criminal profile or relationship systems.

Definitely for the best. I will be going deep into these mechanics, but I appreciate that a lot of people just want to play it more like classic GTA.

I’m also pleasantly surprised that Rockstar has gone down this route. I think a huge issue with their past titles has always been the lack of player freedom, so it’s fantastic to see them aim to improve in that area.
